Shreveport Bicycle Club Saturday Ride

Shreveport, LA · Southeast Shreveport · Road

Unconfirmed — check with the host

Shreveport Bicycle Club Saturday Ride is a road group ride in Shreveport, LA. It rolls every Saturday at 7:30 am from Ellerbe Road Baptist Church.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Shreveport Bicycle Club Saturday Ride group ride

The local road club's Saturday ride from a church lot in southeast Shreveport. The club also rides Tuesdays and Thursdays. Check the club Facebook page for the week's route and any changes.
